159: static bk_err_t pm_cp0_mailbox_send_data(uint32_t cmd, uint32_t param1,uint32_t param2,uint32_t param3)
160: {
161: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t mb_cmd = {0};
162: 	int ret              = 0;
163: 	uint8_t  retry_count = 0;
164: 	bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX,0,0);

180:         }
181: 	}
182: 	bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX,1,0);
183: 	return BK_OK;

243: 		case PM_RTC_DEEPSLEEP_CMD:

265:

325: static bk_err_t pm_openvela_clock_validate(void)
326: {
327: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
328: 	uint32_t clk = sys_drv_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
329: 	uint32_t required = bk_pm_vdddig_required_get(PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);
330: 
331: 	if (bk_pm_module_current_cpu_freq_get(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1) != PM_CPU_FRQ_480M ||
332: 		bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get() != PM_CPU_FRQ_480M ||
333: 		((clk >> 4) & 0x3) != 0x3 || ((clk >> 0) & 0xf) != 0x0 ||
334: 		((clk >> 6) & 0x1) != 0x1 ||
335: 		sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(0) != 0 ||
336: 		sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(1) != 1 ||
337: 		sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(2) != 1 ||
338: 		sys_hal_vdddig_h_vol_get() < required)
339: 	{
340: 		LOGE("OpenVela clock invalid slot/max=%d/%d clk=0x%x "
341: 			"speed=%d/%d/%d vdddig=0x%x need=0x%x\r\n",
342: 			bk_pm_module_current_cpu_freq_get(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1),
343: 			bk_pm_current_max_cpu_freq_get(), clk,
344: 			sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(0), sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(1),
345: 			sys_drv_cpu_clk_div_get(2), sys_hal_vdddig_h_vol_get(), required);
346: 		return BK_FAIL;
347: 	}
348: #if CONFIG_RX_OPTIMIZE
349: 	if (sys_hal_vddd_h_vol_get() < 0x7)
350: 	{
351: 		LOGE("OpenVela VDDD invalid: 0x%x\r\n",
352: 			sys_hal_vddd_h_vol_get());
353: 		return BK_FAIL;
354: 	}
355: #endif
356: #endif
357: 	return BK_OK;
358: }

360: static void pm_openvela_boot_rollback(void)
361: {
362: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
363: 	bk_err_t ret;
364: 
365: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 2)
366: 	{
367: 		ret = bk_cpu2_hold_reset();
368: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
369: 		{
370: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU2 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
371: 			return;
372: 		}
373: 	}
374: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 3)
375: 	{
376: 		ret = bk_cpu1_hold_reset();
377: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
378: 		{
379: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU1 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
380: 			return;
381: 		}
382: 	}
383: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 2)
384: 	{
385: 		ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
386: 		if (ret != BK_OK ||
387: 			sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2) !=
388: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
389: 		{
390: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU2 power off failed: %d state=%d\r\n",
391: 				ret, sys_drv_module_power_state_get(
392: 					PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2));
393: 			return;
394: 		}
395: 	}
396: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 3)
397: 	{
398: 		ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
399: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
400: 		if (ret != BK_OK ||
401: 			sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
402: 			PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
403: 		{
404: 			LOGE("rollback: CPU1 power off failed: %d state=%d\r\n",
405: 				ret, sys_drv_module_power_state_get(
406: 					PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1));
407: 			return;
408: 		}
409: 	}
410: 	if (s_pm_openvela_boot_stage >= 1)
411: 	{
412: 		ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1,
413: 			PM_CPU_FRQ_DEFAULT);
414: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
415: 		{
416: 			LOGE("rollback: frequency release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
417: 			return;
418: 		}
419: 	}
420: 	s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 0;
421: #else
422: 	(void)bk_cpu1_hold_reset();
423: 	(void)bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
424: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
425: #endif
426: }

428: static bk_err_t pm_module_bootup_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
429: {
430: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
431: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
432: 	bk_err_t ret;
433: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
434: 	if (module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1 &&
435: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF != sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
436: 	{
437: 		LOGE("CPU1 powered before OpenVela lifecycle transaction\r\n");
438: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
439: 	}
440: #endif
441: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
442: 	{
443: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
444: 		{
445: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
446: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1, PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);
447: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
448: 				return ret;
449: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 1;
450: 			ret = pm_openvela_clock_validate();
451: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
452: 				goto rollback;
453: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
454: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
455: 				goto rollback;
456: 			if (!bk_cpu2_reset_is_held())
457: 			{
458: 				LOGE("CPU2 is not reset-held ctrl=0x%x run=0x%x\r\n",
459: 					bk_cpu2_ctrl_get(), bk_cpu_run_status_get());
460: 				ret = BK_ERR_STATE;
461: 				goto rollback;
462: 			}
463: 			ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
464: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
465: 				goto rollback;
466: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 2;
467: #else
468: #if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
469: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
470: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
471: 				return ret;
472: #endif
473: #endif
474: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
475: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
476: 			if (ret != BK_OK ||
477: 				sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
478: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
479: 			{
480: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
481: 				if (sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) ==
482: 					PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
483: 					s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 3;
484: #endif
485: 				ret = ret == BK_OK ? BK_FAIL : ret;
486: 				goto rollback;
487: 			}
488: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
489: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 3;
490: #endif
491: 
492: 			#if defined(RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX)
493: 			void reset_forward_log_status(void);
494: 			// reset cpu1's log transfer status on cpu0.
495: 			reset_forward_log_status();
496: 			#endif
497: 
498: 			ret = bk_cpu1_start_partition();
499: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
500: 				goto rollback;
501: 			mb_ipc_reset_notify(1, 1);
502: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
503: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 4;
504: #endif
505: 
506: 			previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
507: 			current_tick = previous_tick;
508: 			while((current_tick - previous_tick) < (PM_BOOT_CP1_WAITING_TIEM*AON_RTC_MS_TICK_CNT))
509: 			{
510: 				if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get()) // wait the cp1 response
511: 				{
512: 					break;
513: 				}
514: 				current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
515: 			}
516: 
517: 			if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
518: 			{
519: 				LOGE("CPU1 boot timeout stage=%d\r\n",
520: 					s_pm_openvela_boot_stage);
521: 				ret = BK_ERR_TIMEOUT;
522: 				goto rollback;
523: 			}
524: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
525: 			s_pm_openvela_boot_stage = 5;
526: 			(void)bk_pm_openvela_diag_dump();
527: #endif
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	return BK_OK;
531: 
532: rollback:
533: 	pm_openvela_boot_rollback();
534: 	(void)bk_pm_openvela_diag_dump();
535: 	return ret;
536: }

545: static bk_err_t pm_module_shutdown_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
546: {
547: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
548: 	GLOBAL_INT_DECLARATION();
549: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
550: 	{
551: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
552: 		{
553: 			#if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
554: 			ret = bk_cpu2_hold_reset();
555: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
556: 			{
557: 				LOGE("shutdown: CPU2 reset hold failed: %d\r\n", ret);
558: 				return ret;
559: 			}
560: 			ret = bk_pm_openvela_cpu2_power_hold(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
561: 			if (ret != BK_OK ||
562: 				sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2) !=
563: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
564: 			{
565: 				LOGE("shutdown: CPU2 power off failed: %d state=%d\r\n",
566: 					ret, sys_drv_module_power_state_get(
567: 						PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU2));
568: 				return ret == BK_OK ? BK_FAIL : ret;
569: 			}
570: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(
571: 				PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_OPENVELA,
572: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
573: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
574: 			{
575: 				LOGE("shutdown: OpenVela PSRAM release failed: %d\r\n", ret);
576: 				return ret;
577: 			}
578: 			#endif
579: 			stop_cpu1_core();
580: 			#if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
581: 			bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
582: 			#endif
583: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1,
584: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
585: 			if (ret != BK_OK ||
586: 				sys_drv_module_power_state_get(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1) !=
587: 				PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
588: 			{

729: uint32_t bk_pm_get_cp1_psram_malloc_count(uint32_t using_psram_type)
730: {
731: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
732: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
733: 	if(s_pm_cp1_boot_ready)
734: 	{
735: 		bk_pm_cp0_psram_malloc_state_set(PM_MAILBOX_COMMUNICATION_INIT);
736: 		pm_cp0_mailbox_send_data(PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,using_psram_type,0,0);
737: 		if(using_psram_type == 0x0)
738: 		{
739: 			s_pm_cp1_psram_malloc_count = 0;
740: 			previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
741: 			current_tick = previous_tick;
742: 			while((current_tick - previous_tick) < (PM_SEND_CMD_CP1_RESPONSE_TIEM*AON_RTC_MS_TICK_CNT))
743: 			{
744: 				if (bk_pm_cp0_psram_malloc_state_get()) // wait the cp1 response
745: 				{
746: 					break;
747: 				}
748: 				current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
749: 			}
750: 			if(!bk_pm_cp0_psram_malloc_state_get())
751: 			{
752: 				BK_LOGD(NULL,"cp0 get the psram malloc state[%d] time out > 100ms\r\n",using_psram_type);
753: 			}
754: 
755: 			return s_pm_cp1_psram_malloc_count;
756: 		}
757: 	}
758: 	else
759: 	{
760: 		return 0;
761: 	}
762: 	return 0;
763: }

901: static bk_err_t pm_psram_power_ctrl(pm_power_psram_module_name_e module,pm_power_module_state_e power_state)
902: {
903: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
904: #if CONFIG_PSRAM
905: 	GLOBAL_INT_DECLARATION();
906: 	uint32_t owner_bit;
907: 
908: 	if (module >= PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MAX)
909: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
910: 	owner_bit = 0x1U << module;
911: 
912:     if(power_state == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)//power on
913:     {
914: 		if (s_pm_psram_ctrl_state & owner_bit)
915: 			return BK_OK;
916: 		if(s_pm_psram_ctrl_state == 0)
917: 		{
918: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_vdddig_ctrl(PM_VDDDIG_MODULE_PSRAM,
919: 				PM_VDDDIG_HIGH_STATE_ON);
920: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
921: 				return ret;
922: 		}
923: 		ret = bk_psram_init();
924: 		if(ret != BK_OK)
925: 		{
926: 			LOGE("psram init owner=%d ret=%d\r\n", module, ret);
927: 			if (s_pm_psram_ctrl_state == 0)
928: 				bk_pm_module_vote_vdddig_ctrl(PM_VDDDIG_MODULE_PSRAM,
929: 					PM_VDDDIG_HIGH_STATE_OFF);
930: 			return ret;
931: 		}
932: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
933: 		s_pm_psram_ctrl_state |= owner_bit;
934:         GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
935: 	}
936:     else //power down
937:     {
938: 		if(s_pm_psram_ctrl_state & owner_bit)
939: 		{
940: 			GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
941: 			s_pm_psram_ctrl_state &= ~owner_bit;
942: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
943: 			#if !CONFIG_PM_PSRAM_FORCE_ON
944: 			if(0x0 == s_pm_psram_ctrl_state)
945: 			{
946: 				ret = bk_psram_deinit();
947: 				if (ret != BK_OK)
948: 				{
949: 					GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
950: 					s_pm_psram_ctrl_state |= owner_bit;
951: 					GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
952: 					return ret;
953: 				}
954: 				bk_pm_module_vote_vdddig_ctrl(PM_VDDDIG_MODULE_PSRAM,PM_VDDDIG_HIGH_STATE_OFF);
955: 				FIXED_ADDR_PSRAM_POWER_DOWN = PM_PSRAM_POWER_DOWN_MAGIC;
956:                 bk_pm_get_cp1_psram_malloc_count(0x1);
957: 			}
958: 			#endif
959: 		}
960: 	}
961: #endif
962: 	return ret;
963: }

1032: uint32_t bk_pm_vdddig_required_get(pm_cpu_freq_e cpu_freq)
1033: {
1034: 	const cpu_freq_vdddig_t map[] = CPU_FREQ_VDDDIG_MAP;
1035: 	uint32_t target = PM_VDDDIG_DEFAULT;
1036: 
1037: 	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < sizeof(map) / sizeof(map[0]); i++)
1038: 	{
1039: 		if (map[i].cpu_freq == cpu_freq)
1040: 		{
1041: 			target = map[i].vdddig;
1042: 			break;
1043: 		}
1044: 	}
1045: 	if ((s_pm_vdddig_ctrl_state & (0x1U << PM_VDDDIG_MODULE_PSRAM)) &&
1046: 		target < PM_VDDDIG_095)
1047: 		target = PM_VDDDIG_095;
1048: 	if ((s_pm_vdddig_ctrl_state & (0x1U << PM_VDDDIG_MODULE_CPU_FREQ)) &&
1049: 		target < PM_VDDDIG_095)
1050: 		target = PM_VDDDIG_095;
1051: 	return target;
1052: }

232: 		return;
233: 	}

235: 	while(1)

239: 		if(events == 0)

242: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;

250: 			}
251: 		}
252: 
253: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
254: 		{
255: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
256: 
257: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
258: 			{
259: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
260: 
261: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
262: 				{
263: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
264: 					{
265: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
266: 						break;  // cpu1 power on.
267: 					}
268: 				}
269: 				else
270: 				{
271: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
272: 					{
273: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
274: 						// restart_cpu_x();

276: 					}

278: 					{

280: 					}
281: 				}
282: 
283: 				retry_cnt++;
284: 			}
285: 
286: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
287: 		}
288: 
289: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
290: 		{
291: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
292: 			{

301: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)

129:           if (ret == -EBUSY)
130:             {
131:               failures = ++heartbeat_busy;
132:             }
133:           else if (ret == -ENOLINK)
134:             {
135:               failures = ++heartbeat_nolink;
136:             }
137:           else if (ret == -ETIMEDOUT)
138:             {
139:               failures = ++heartbeat_timeout;
140:             }
141:           else
142:             {
143:               failures = ++heartbeat_other;
144:             }
145: 
146:           if ((failures & (failures - 1u)) == 0)
147:             {
148:               syslog(LOG_ERR,
149:                       "heartbeat send=%d busy=%lu link=%lu timeout=%lu "
150:                       "other=%lu\n",
151:                       ret, (unsigned long)heartbeat_busy,
152:                       (unsigned long)heartbeat_nolink,
153:                       (unsigned long)heartbeat_timeout,
154:                       (unsigned long)heartbeat_other);
155:             }
156:         }
157:     }
158:   return 0;
159: }

161: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
162: {
163:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
164:   struct pwc_message message;
165:   unsigned int next;
166:   irqstate_t flags;
167: 
168:   if (bytes == NULL)
169:     {
170:       return;
171:     }
172: 
173:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
174:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
175:   if (next == g_tail)
176:     {
177:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
178:       return;
179:     }
180: 
181:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
182:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
183:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
184:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
185:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
186:   g_head = next;
187:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
188:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
189: }

191: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
192: {
193:   int ret;
194: 
195:   (void)argc;
196:   (void)argv;
197:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
198:   g_worker_result = ret < 0 ? -EXDEV : OK;
199:   g_worker_ready = ret >= 0;
200:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
201:   if (ret < 0)
202:     {
203:       return -EXDEV;
204:     }
205: 
206:   for (;;)
207:     {
208:       struct pwc_message message;
209:       irqstate_t flags;
210: 
211:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
212:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
213:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
214:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
215:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
216:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
217:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
218:         {
219:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
220:             g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
221:             g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
222:             g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
223:             if (g_psram_power_waiting)
224:               {
225:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
226:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
227:               }
228:             break;
229: 
230: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
231:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
232:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
233:               {
234:                 (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
235:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
236:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
237:                   bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
238:               }
239:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
240:               {
241:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
242: 
243:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
244:               }
245:             break;
246: 
247:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
248:             bk7258_psram_dump();
249:             break;
250: 
251:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
252:             {
253:               int shutdown_ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
254: 
255:               (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
256:                 PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
257:                 shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
258:                                     PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
259:             }
260:             break;
261: #endif
262: 
263:           default:
264:             break;
265:         }
266:     }
267:   return 0;
268: }

270: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
271: {
272:   int pid;
273:   int ret;
274: 
275:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
276:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
277:   nxsem_init(&g_heartbeat_sem, 0, 0);
278:   nxsem_init(&g_psram_power_sem, 0, 0);
279:   g_head = 0;
280:   g_tail = 0;
281:   g_worker_ready = false;
282:   g_worker_result = -EINPROGRESS;
283:   g_heartbeat_result = -EINPROGRESS;
284:   g_ready_sent = false;
285:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
286:   g_psram_power_state = PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF;
287:   g_psram_power_result = -EINPROGRESS;
288:   g_psram_power_version = 0;
289:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
290:   /* Match Armino mb_ipc_heartbeat: notify CPU0 before PM ready and keep the
291:    * CPU1 liveness indication independent from the PWC worker. */
292:   if (bk7258_mbox_send_message(1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
293:     {
294:       return -1;
295:     }
296: 
297:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
298:   if (ret < 0)
299:     {
300:       printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
301:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
302:       return ret;
303:     }
304:   printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport complete\n");
305: 
306:   pid = kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536, ipc_heartbeat_worker,
307:                        NULL);
308:   if (pid < 0)
309:     {
310:       return pid;
311:     }
312:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_heartbeat_sem,
313:                                      MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0)
314:     {
315:       printf("PWC: heartbeat worker start timeout\n");
316:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
317:     }
318:   if (g_heartbeat_result < 0)
319:     {
320:       printf("PWC: heartbeat worker affinity failed, error=%d\n",
321:              g_heartbeat_result);
322:       return g_heartbeat_result;
323:     }
324: 
325:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
326:   if (pid < 0)
327:     {
328:       return pid;
329:     }
330:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0)
331:     {
332:       printf("PWC: worker start timeout\n");
333:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
334:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
335:     }
336:   if (g_worker_result < 0 || !g_worker_ready)
337:     {
338:       printf("PWC: worker affinity failed, error=%d\n", g_worker_result);
339:       return g_worker_result < 0 ? g_worker_result : -EIO;
340:     }
341:   printf("PWC: worker ready\n");
342: 
343:   /* CP boots CPU1 from its low-power worker and waits there for this ready
344:    * command. Send it before requesting PSRAM, whose vote is handled by that
345:    * same worker, otherwise the two cores deadlock waiting for each other.
346:    */
347: 
348:   g_ready_sent = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD,
349:                                          1, 0, 0) == 0;
350:   if (!g_ready_sent)
351:     {
352:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready queue failed\n");
353:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
354:       return -EIO;
355:     }
356: 
357:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
358:   if (ret < 0)
359:     {
360:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
361:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
362:       return ret;
363:     }
364: 
365:   printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready acknowledged by CP transport\n");
366: 
367: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
368:   g_psram_power_waiting = true;
369:   g_psram_power_result = -EINPROGRESS;
370:   g_psram_power_version = 0;
371:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
372:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
373:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON,
374:                                 PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1);
375:   if (ret >= 0)
376:     {
377:       ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_psram_power_sem,
378:                          MSEC2TICK(PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS));
379:     }
380: 
381:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
382:   if (ret < 0 || g_psram_power_version != PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1 ||
383:       g_psram_power_result != 0 ||
384:       g_psram_power_state != PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
385:     {
386:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power response failed, transport=%d result=%ld "
387:              "state=%lu version=%lu\n", ret,
388:              (long)g_psram_power_result,
389:              (unsigned long)g_psram_power_state,
390:              (unsigned long)g_psram_power_version);
391:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
392:       psram_power_vote_rollback();
393: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
394:       return ret < 0 ? ret :
395:              g_psram_power_result != 0 ? g_psram_power_result : -EIO;
396: #endif
397:     }
398:   else
399:     {
400:       /* printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote ON acknowledged\n"); */
401:       ret = bk7258_psram_initialize();
402:       if (ret < 0)
403:         {
404:           printf("PWC: PSRAM allocator initialization failed, error=%d\n",
405:                  ret);
406:           psram_power_vote_rollback();
407: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
408:           return ret;
409: #endif
410:         }
411:       else
412:         {
413:           /* printf("PWC: PSRAM allocators ONLINE\n"); */
414:         }
415:     }
416: #endif
417: 
418:   if (g_ready_sent)
419:     {
420:       return 0;
421:     }
422: 
423:   return -1;
424: }

83:     BK7258_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_BASE + BK7258_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_SIZE - 4u,

116:     }

430: bk_err_t sys_hal_core_bus_clock_ctrl(uint32_t cksel_core, uint32_t ckdiv_core,uint32_t ckdiv_bus, uint32_t ckdiv_cpu0,uint32_t ckdiv_cpu1)
431: {
432: 	uint32_t clk_param  = 0;
433: 	uint32_t     h_vol  = 0;
434: 	uint32_t old_clk;
435: 	uint32_t old_cpu[3];
436: 	if(cksel_core > 3)
437: 	{
438: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"set dvfs cksel core > 3 invalid %d\r\n",cksel_core);
439: 		return BK_FAIL;
440: 	}
441: 
442: 	if((ckdiv_core > PM_FREQUNCY_DIV_MAX) || (ckdiv_bus > PM_FREQUNCY_DIV_BUS_MAX)||(ckdiv_cpu1 > PM_FREQUNCY_DIV_CPU_MAX)||(ckdiv_cpu0 > PM_FREQUNCY_DIV_CPU_MAX))
443: 	{
444: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"set dvfs ckdiv_core ckdiv_bus ckdiv_cpu0_1  ckdiv_cpu0_1  > 1 invalid\r\n");
445: 		return BK_FAIL;
446: 	}
447: 	if((cksel_core == PM_CLKSEL_CORE_320M)&&(ckdiv_core == PM_CLKDIV_CORE_0)&&(ckdiv_cpu0 != PM_CLKDV_CPU0_0))
448: 	{
449: 		BK_LOGD(NULL,"unsupport the cpu freq setting %d %d %d\r\n",cksel_core,ckdiv_core,ckdiv_cpu0);
450: 		return BK_FAIL;
451: 	}
452: 
453: 	if((cksel_core == PM_CLKSEL_CORE_320M)&&(ckdiv_core == PM_CLKDIV_CORE_0))
454: 	{
455: 		h_vol = sys_hal_vdddig_h_vol_get();
456: 		if(h_vol < PM_VDDDIG_H_VOL_0v9)
457: 		{
458: 			sys_hal_ctrl_vddd_h_vol(PM_VDDD_H_VOL_1V);
459: 			sys_hal_ctrl_vdddig_h_vol(PM_VDDDIG_H_VOL_0v9);
460: 		}
461: 	}
462: 	old_clk = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
463: 	old_cpu[0] = sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(0);
464: 	old_cpu[1] = sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(1);
465: 	old_cpu[2] = sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(2);
466: 	clk_param = 0;
467: 	clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
468: 	if(((clk_param >> 0x4)&0x3) > cksel_core)//when it from the higher frequency to lower frequency
469: 	{
470: 		/*1.core clk select*/
471: 		clk_param = 0;
472: 		clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
473: 		clk_param &=  ~(0x3 << 4);
474: 		clk_param |=  cksel_core << 4;
475: 		sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_set(CLK_DIV_REG0,clk_param);
476: 
477: 		/*2.config bus and core clk div*/
478: 		clk_param = 0;
479: 		clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
480: 		clk_param &= ~((0xF << 0) | (0x1 << 6));
481: 		clk_param |= (ckdiv_core << 0) | (ckdiv_bus << 6);
482: 		sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_set(CLK_DIV_REG0,clk_param);
483: 
484: 		/*3.config cpu clk div*/
485: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(0,ckdiv_cpu0);
486: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(1,ckdiv_cpu1);
487: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(2,1);//config cpu2
488: 	}
489: 	else//when it from the lower frequency to higher frequency
490: 	{
491: 		/*1.config bus and core clk div*/
492: 		if(ckdiv_core == 0)
493: 		{
494: 			sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(0,ckdiv_cpu0);//avoid the bus freq > 240m
495: 		}
496: 
497: 		clk_param = 0;
498: 		clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
499: 		clk_param &= ~((0xF << 0) | (0x1 << 6));
500: 		clk_param |= (ckdiv_core << 0) | (ckdiv_bus << 6);
501: 		sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_set(CLK_DIV_REG0,clk_param);
502: 
503: 		/*2.config cpu clk div*/
504: 		if(ckdiv_core != 0)
505: 		{
506: 			sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(0,ckdiv_cpu0);
507: 		}
508: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(1,ckdiv_cpu1);
509: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(2,1);//config cpu2
510: 
511: 		/*3.core clk select*/
512: 
513: 		clk_param = 0;
514: 		clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
515: 		clk_param &=  ~(0x3 << 4);
516: 		clk_param |=  cksel_core << 4;
517: 		sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_set(CLK_DIV_REG0,clk_param);
518: 	}
519: 
520: 	clk_param = sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_get(CLK_DIV_REG0);
521: 	if (((clk_param >> 4) & 0x3) != cksel_core ||
522: 		((clk_param >> 0) & 0xF) != ckdiv_core ||
523: 		((clk_param >> 6) & 0x1) != ckdiv_bus ||
524: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(0) != ckdiv_cpu0 ||
525: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(1) != ckdiv_cpu1 ||
526: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(2) != 1)
527: 	{
528: 		BK_LOGE(NULL, "dvfs readback mismatch clk=0x%x cpu=%d/%d/%d\r\n",
529: 			clk_param, sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(0),
530: 			sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(1), sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_get(2));
531: 		sys_hal_all_modules_clk_div_set(CLK_DIV_REG0, old_clk);
532: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(0, old_cpu[0]);
533: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(1, old_cpu[1]);
534: 		sys_hal_cpu_clk_div_set(2, old_cpu[2]);
535: 		return BK_FAIL;
536: 	}
537: 
538: 	return BK_OK;
539: }

436: bk_err_t pm_management(uint32_t sleep_ticks)
437: {
438: #if CONFIG_MCU_PS
439: #if CONFIG_PM_LIGHT_SLEEP
440: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
441: 	uint64_t current_tick = 0;
442: 	uint64_t missed_ticks = 0;
443: 	int ret = 0;
444: 	if (s_pm_mcu_pm_state)
445: 	{
446: 		return BK_OK;
447: 	}
448: 
449: 	if ((s_pm_light_sleep_enter_cb_conf.cb == NULL) || (s_pm_light_sleep_exit_cb_conf.cb == NULL))
450: 	{
451: 
452: 		return BK_FAIL;
453: 	}
454: 	ret = s_pm_light_sleep_enter_cb_conf.cb(sleep_ticks * rtos_get_ms_per_tick(), s_pm_light_sleep_enter_cb_conf.args);

456: 	{
457: 		return BK_FAIL;
458: 	}
459: 	previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);

462: 	{
463: 		current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
464: 	}
465: 
466: 	// BK_LOGD(NULL,"idle task after:%d \r\n",sleep_ticks);
467: 	missed_ticks = pm_state_machine();
468: 	missed_ticks = sleep_ticks;
469: 	// bk_update_tick(missed_ticks);
470: 
471: 	s_pm_light_sleep_exit_cb_conf.cb(sleep_ticks * rtos_get_ms_per_tick(), s_pm_light_sleep_exit_cb_conf.args);
472: #else
473: 	uint32_t missed_ticks = 0;
474: 	if (s_pm_mcu_pm_state)
475: 	{
476: 		return BK_OK;
477: 	}
478: 	missed_ticks = pm_state_machine();
479: 	if (missed_ticks != 0)
480: 	{
481: 		// bk_update_tick(missed_ticks);
482: 	}
483: #endif
484: 
485: #endif
486: 	return BK_OK;
487: }

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/cli_main.c` | 注册 `ap_console` CLI 命令 |
12: | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | `cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c` | UART0 CP_CLI/AP_CONSOLE owner 状态机、延迟切换和退出转义 |
13: | `cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c` | `cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c` | DVFS 错误传播、vote/cache rollback 和 CPU/PSRAM 联合 VDDDIG 下限 |
14: | `cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c` | `cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c` | CPU1/CPU2 语义化 reset helper、run-status readback |
15: | `cp/components/controller_if/cif_ipc.c` | `cp/components/controller_if/cif_ipc.c` | 保留 Wi-Fi IPC RX status callback ABI |
16: | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | `cp/include/components/ap_console_bridge.h` | CP UART0 bridge 模式、写入和统计接口 |
17: | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | `cp/include/components/shell_task.h` | shell 与 bridge 的切换/链路事件接口 |
18: | `cp/include/components/system.h` | `cp/include/components/system.h` | CPU reset/readback 语义化接口 |
19: | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | `cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h` | transport event、诊断和 poll 接口 |
20: | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | `cp/include/driver/mb_uart_driver.h` | MB_UART link event、状态和 poll 接口 |
21: | `cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h` | `cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h` | PSRAM V1、OpenVela lifecycle 与 PM 诊断接口 |
22: | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | MB_UART0 唯一 owner、LOG/RAW RX、1024 B TX ring 和 worker |
23: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c` | 完整 ACK 匹配、timeout/reset、probe 和诊断 |
24: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_cmd.c` | IPC power-up ready 门禁事件 |
25: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c` | heartbeat/reset/down 自动回退事件 |
26: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_uart_driver.c` | 严格 DATA/STATE 校验、ACK 后推进和 link event |
27: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c` | command/ACK/reset/sync 分离稳定 slot |
28: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.h` | 稳定 slot 完成和 quarantine 接口 |
29: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c` | RX 资源门禁、FIFO poll 和 destination count |
30: | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.h` | `cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.h` | MBOX0 poll、ready callback 和 FIFO count API |
31: | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/Kconfig` | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/Kconfig` | 默认关闭的 `CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` 开关 |
32: | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/low_pwr_core.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/low_pwr_core.c` | PSRAM V1 真实 ret/version 与 PM readback response |
33: | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c` | 480 MHz staged boot、CPU2 power-only、PSRAM owner 和 shutdown rollback |
34: | `cp/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_ps_driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_ps_driver.c` | 单目标 DVFS 切换与错误/cache 传播 |
35: | `cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c` | `cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c` | bus divider bit 6、寄存器 readback 与失败恢复 |
36: | `cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/include/sys_hal.h` | `cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/include/sys_hal.h` | VDDD/VDDDIG readback API |
37: | `projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c` | `projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c` | OpenVela boot transaction 启动与失败 fail-stop |
38: | `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config` | `projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config` | app_ab CP 启用 OpenVela 480 MHz lifecycle |
39: | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | BK7258 640 KiB Share SRAM 和 16 MiB PSRAM 布局 |
40: 
41: UART0 bridge 保持 `MB_UART0` 唯一初始化 owner。AP 输出 LOG 模式保留 `ap0:`
42: 前缀、50 ms 半行刷新和有限重试；RAW 模式不改写字节。PC 到 AP 输入使用
43: 1024 B 有界 ring 和部分写 worker，所有物理 UART0 输出仍经 shell queue 串行化。
44: 
45: `ram_regions.csv`采用原厂 `lvgl/img_decode`、`lvgl/freetype_font` 的 16 MiB
46: 七区域布局：
47: 
48: ```text
49: 0x60000000..0x60700000  四个媒体 slab，共 7 MiB
50: 0x60700000..0x60720000  CP PSRAM heap，128 KiB
51: 0x60720000..0x60a00000  AP PSRAM heap，2.875 MiB
52: 0x60a00000..0x61000000  AP PSRAM section，6 MiB
53: ```

136: ## 3. 正确构建链条
137: 
138: 最终固件链条固定为：
139: 
140: ```text
141: OpenVela nuttx.bin
142:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
143:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
144:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
145:   -> package/all-app.bin
146: 
147: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
148:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
149: ```

151: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
152: 
153: - `ram_regions.csv`
154: - AP/CP `config`

160: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
161: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。

163: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：

295: ## 7. UART0 Mailbox V2 使用和边界
296: 
297: CP 启动后默认 owner 为 `CP_CLI`。只有 MB_UART0 STATE 成功 ACK、IPC power-up 和
298: PWC boot-ready 三个条件同时成立，且`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`非零时，
299: `ap_console open`才允许进入。heartbeat timeout、AP reset/power-off 和 Mailbox
300: reset/timeout都会清除门禁并请求回退到CP CLI。使用方式：
301: 
302: ```text
303: ap_console status
304: ap_console open
305: <RAW AP NSH interaction>
306: <press Ctrl-], release it, then press .>
307: ap_console status
308: ```
309: 
310: `open`在当前 CP CLI 响应经 UART TX-complete 后生效，并清 CP parser 和 UART RX；
311: RAW 模式不添加前缀。退出时按下`Ctrl-]`、松开，再按`.`；该转义不依赖行首状态。
312: 链路 reset/timeout/down 时自动清理
313: 未发送输入并回到 `CP_CLI`。`status`输出 owner/link/mode、bridge ring、MB_UART 状态、
314: active channel/sequence/command 和 drop/partial/overflow/reset/timeout 统计。
315:

317: 故障注入和长时间双向压力。这些仍须按移植计划测试矩阵完成。

244: bk_err_t sys_drv_switch_cpu_bus_freq(pm_cpu_freq_e cpu_bus_freq)
245: {
246: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_FAIL;
247: 	pm_cpu_freq_e prev_freq = s_cpu_freq;
248: 
249: 	if(prev_freq == cpu_bus_freq)
250: 		return BK_OK;
251: 
252: 	switch(cpu_bus_freq)
253: 	{
254: 		case PM_CPU_FRQ_480M:
255: 		case PM_CPU_FRQ_320M:
256: 		case PM_CPU_FRQ_240M:
257: 		case PM_CPU_FRQ_120M:
258: 		case PM_CPU_FRQ_80M:
259: 		case PM_CPU_FRQ_60M:
260: 		case PM_CPU_FRQ_26M:
261: 			break;
262: 
263: 		default:
264: 			return BK_FAIL;
265: 			break;
266: 	}
267: 
268: 	uint32_t int_level = sys_drv_enter_critical();
269: 	ret = sys_hal_switch_cpu_bus_freq(cpu_bus_freq);
270: 	if (ret == BK_OK)
271: 		s_cpu_freq = cpu_bus_freq;
272: 	sys_drv_exit_critical(int_level);
273: 
274: 	return ret;
275: }

76:       "mrs r1, control\n"
77:       "orr r1, r1, #2\n"

111:       "str r0, [r1]\n"
112:       "ldr r0, =__secondary_boot_stack_base\n"

118: int up_cpu_start(int cpu)
119: {
120:   clock_t started;
121:   uint32_t control;
122:   uint32_t status;
123: 
124:   if (cpu != 1 || this_cpu() != 0)
125:     {
126:       return -EINVAL;
127:     }
128: 
129:   status = getreg32(BK7258_CPU_RUN_STATUS);
130:   if ((status & BK7258_CPU_STATUS_CPU2_POWER_DOWN) != 0 ||
131:       !bk7258_mbox_smp_ready())
132:     {
133:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "CPU2 prerequisite failed: status=%08lx mbox=%u\n",
134:              (unsigned long)status, bk7258_mbox_smp_ready());
135:       PANIC();
136:     }
137: 
138:   bk7258_cpu2_hold_reset();
139:   control = getreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL);
140:   status = getreg32(BK7258_CPU_RUN_STATUS);
141:   if ((control & BK7258_CPU2_RESET_RELEASE) != 0 ||
142:       (status & BK7258_CPU_STATUS_CPU2_RESET) != 0)
143:     {
144:       syslog(LOG_ERR, "CPU2 reset hold failed: ctrl=%08lx status=%08lx\n",
145:              (unsigned long)control, (unsigned long)status);
146:       PANIC();
147:     }
148: 
149:   atomic_set(&g_cpu2_online, 0);
150:   bk7258_smp_prepare_boot();
151:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN0);
152:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1);
153:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU2_CONTROL, BK7258_CPU2_OFFSET_MASK,
154:               BK7258_CPU2_RXEVT_SEL |
155:               (((uintptr_t)__secondary_vectors_start >> 8) <<

428: static bk_err_t pm_module_bootup_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
429: {
430: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
431: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
432: 	bk_err_t ret;
433: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
434: 	if (module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1 &&
435: 		PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF != sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
436: 	{
437: 		LOGE("CPU1 powered before OpenVela lifecycle transaction\r\n");
438: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
439: 	}
440: #endif
441: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
442: 	{
443: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
444: 		{
445: #if CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M
446: 			ret = bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_CPU1, PM_CPU_FRQ_480M);

450: 			ret = pm_openvela_clock_validate();

text:
**Findings**

1. **[严重] CP 在必需 PSRAM 完成前提交 boot transaction，后续 PSRAM 失败不会触发 CP rollback。**  
   AP 先发送 `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD` 并等待 transport ACK，[bk7258_pm_pwc.c:343](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:343)，然后才请求 V1 PSRAM vote、probe 和初始化 allocator，[bk7258_pm_pwc.c:367](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:367)。CP 收到前一个 ready 后立即结束等待并把 stage 置为 5，[pwr_clk.c:506](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:506)、[pwr_clk.c:524](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:524)。最终 OpenVela 配置明确启用了 `CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED=y`，[.config:240](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/.config:240)。因此 V1 timeout、probe alias 或 `mm_initialize()` 失败时，AP bring-up 停止，但 CP 仍认为 OpenVela 已成功启动并永久保留 CPU1/CPU2、480 MHz 和 sleep veto。  
   **最小修复：**把协议改成两阶段 `BOOTED`/`COMMIT`。第一阶段只解除 CP worker 的等待，让其处理 PSRAM 请求；只有 PSRAM allocator 和 SMP CPU2 均完成后 AP 才发 `COMMIT`。失败必须发 `ABORT(error)`，由 CP 执行完整 rollback。

2. **[严重] shutdown recovery 的任一拒绝或发送失败都会把 lifecycle 永久卡在 `closing`。**  
   CP 先清掉最后一个 boot vote、置 `s_pm_cp1_closing=1`，然后忽略 recovery 命令发送结果，[pwr_clk.c:683](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:683)。AP 只要存在一个 PSRAM allocation，`bk7258_psram_shutdown()` 就返回 `-EBUSY`，[bk7258_psram.c:203](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_psram.c:203)，但 recovery response 仅把它编码为 `INIT`，且发送返回值也被丢弃，[bk7258_pm_pwc.c:251](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:251)。CP 收到 `INIT` 后只是清 recovery bit，[pwr_clk.c:297](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:297)，不会恢复原 boot vote、清 `closing` 或安排重试。之后所有启动都在 semaphore 上等待 20 秒，而该 semaphore 只会在成功 shutdown 后释放，[pwr_clk.c:639](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:639)。  
   **最小修复：**response 增加真实 `status`；`-EBUSY`/发送失败时 CP 恢复被清除的 boot vote、清 `closing` 并唤醒 waiter。只有显式 `FINISH` 才进入硬件 shutdown；所有 mailbox send 都必须检查并处理错误。

3. **[高] AP recovery 没有 quiesce NuttX SMP CPU2，CP 会直接 reset/power-off 一个仍可能持锁的核。**  
   AP 的 recovery handler 只检查并销毁 PSRAM heaps，随后立即回复完成，[bk7258_pm_pwc.c:251](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:251)。它没有停止 CPU2 调度、执行跨核 barrier 或确认 CPU2 未持有 NuttX spinlock。CP 收到完成后首先 hold CPU2 reset 并断 CPU2 电源，[pwr_clk.c:553](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:553)。最终 AP 是双核 SMP，[.config:426](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/.config:426)，CPU2 确实由 `up_cpu_start()` 启动，[bk7258_cpustart.c:118](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_cpustart.c:118)。这可能留下永久锁、半完成 DMA/cache ownership 或共享结构损坏。  
   **最小修复：**AP 在回复 `FINISH` 前通过 SMP call 将 CPU2 park 到禁中断的 WFE 循环，并确认所有跨核锁及 DMA/media lease 已释放；无法 quiesce 时返回错误并取消 shutdown。

4. **[高] 最终 CP 固件保留可绕过 power-only hold 的 legacy CPU2 控制命令。**  
   `bootcore 2 1/0` 直接启动、停止和切断 CPU2 电源，[cli_misc.c:253](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/cli_misc.c:253)、[cli_misc.c:666](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/cli_misc.c:666)。它完全不检查 `s_pm_openvela_cpu2_held`。更严重的是 `start_cpu2_core()` 对 `get_partition_addr(2)` 使用未支持的 CPU id，得到 0 后写入 legacy boot offset 并释放 reset，[system_main.c:146](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:146)、[system_main.c:294](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:294)。最终配置同时启用了 `CPU_CNT=3`、CLI、ATE 和 OpenVela lifecycle，[config:11](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:11)、[config:161](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:161)、[config:929](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:929)，map 也确认 `boot_cpu_core` 和 `start_cpu2_core` 已链接。执行该命令会破坏正在运行的 OpenVela CPU2。  
   **最小修复：**`CONFIG_OPENVELA_AP_480M` 下编译掉所有 legacy CPU2 start/stop/ATE 路径，或统一通过单一 owner API，并在 OpenVela hold 存在时返回 `BK_ERR_BUSY`。

5. **[高] boot rollback 和正常 shutdown 都泄漏 CPU1 sleep veto；失败 rollback 还留下错误 heartbeat 状态。**  
   boot 无条件清除 `PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1`，[pwr_clk.c:453](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:453)，但 rollback 完全不恢复它，[pwr_clk.c:360](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:360)。正常 shutdown 的恢复调用位于 `CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV` 条件内，而最终配置明确关闭该选项，[config:950](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:950)。一次启动尝试后 CP 将永久失去低压准入。rollback 还直接 hold/power-off CPU1，没有调用 `mb_ipc_reset_notify(1, 0)`；heartbeat 可能永久停在不检查 timeout 的 `CORE_STARTING`，[mb_ipc_heartbeat.c:123](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/mailbox/mb_ipc_heartbeat.c:123)。此外 rollback 每一步失败都会立即 `return`，导致后续 CPU、电压和频率资源不再清理。  
   **最小修复：**记录 sleep vote acquisition stage；rollback 和正常 shutdown 都无条件成对恢复。rollback 改为 best-effort 全清理、累计首个错误，最后调用 reset/down notification 和 bridge link-down，不能中途返回。

6. **[高] CP PSRAM 初始化失败会留下物理 power/clock 开启，但 owner bit 未建立。**  
   `bk_psram_init()` 先执行 `psram_hal_power_clk_enable(1)`，[psram_driver.c:302](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:302)，若 ID/config 初始化失败则直接返回，[psram_driver.c:314](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:314)。调用方随后不置 PSRAM owner，并尝试撤销 VDDDIG owner，[pwr_clk.c:923](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:923)。结果是 owner mask 显示无人使用，但 PSRAM/AHBP 时钟或电源仍开启，甚至可能在降低 VDDDIG 后处于非法组合。  
   **最小修复：**`bk_psram_init()` 在所有 `power_clk_enable(1)` 之后的失败出口执行 `psram_hal_power_clk_enable(0)`，并恢复初始化期间修改的 PHY/channel 状态。

7. **[中] DVFS 二次 rollback 失败后软件 cache 仍声称旧频率，且 VDDDIG owner release 错误被吞掉。**  
   HAL rollback 失败只记录日志，仍返回原错误，[sys_hal.c:741](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:741)。上层因此保留 `s_pre_cpu_freq`、`s_cpu_freq`、`s_pm_current_cpu_freq` 的旧值；下一次相同 vote 会在 cache 命中时直接返回成功，[pm.c:2259](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c:2259)，即使实际 divider 已处于中间状态。降低频率后的 VDDDIG owner release 返回值也被忽略，[pm.c:2282](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c:2282)，会造成高压 owner 泄漏和错误诊断。  
   **最小修复：**rollback 失败时把 DVFS 状态标记为 `UNKNOWN`，以寄存器 readback 重建所有 cache，禁止 cache fast-path；传播 VDDDIG release 错误并保留可重试的 cleanup 状态。

8. **[中] AP 的 PSRAM rollback 只等待 transport ACK，不等待或校验 V1 应用响应。**  
   `psram_power_vote_rollback()` 发送 OFF 后只调用 `bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc()`，[bk7258_pm_pwc.c:75](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c:75)；该 wait 仅等待逻辑 channel transport 完成，[bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:1215](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:1215)。它没有等待 CP 的 `state=OFF/result/version=V1` response。OFF 被拒绝、迟到或丢失时，AP 已返回失败，而 CP 的 OpenVela owner 11 可能永久残留。  
   **最小修复：**rollback 复用独立 transaction semaphore，等待并严格验证 OFF、真实 result 和 V1 version；加入 generation/transaction id，隔离 timeout 后的迟到响应。
